packages.description:
analog-canvas-extensions 0.1.
Generated by build-std.mjs in rnl-dev (notes/analog-canvas-rnl-import-export/std-0.3, eb3a4ce)
from Analog Canvas 5008996af (packages/components/definitions), symbol-list.json (rnl-dev 693cc69)
and the hand-written parts there; from here on edited in rnl, whose files are the source.
Not standard: Analog Canvas's appearance variants of standard symbols, named $CANVAS_ and its
component id, and its chopper. A file names it with USE-PACKAGE (16.2); the core bundles it.
Written in the language 0.3, as the standard series 0.3 is.
Coordinates are y-up; one unit is one grid step, ten Analog Canvas units. Pins bind by terminal
number, so a symbol fits any dialect.

packages.name: analog-canvas-extensions

summary.en: Analog Canvas’s own package for the language 0.4: its look variants of standard symbols, its four-input gates and four-terminal MOSFETs, and the definitions of meaning only that bring a file it writes back to it unchanged.

packages.description:
analog-canvas-extensions 0.7, the Analog Canvas package for the language 0.4.
Not standard: Analog Canvas's appearance variants of standard symbols, named $CANVAS_ and its
component id, its four-input gates, its four-terminal MOSFETs with the body pin at (1, 0), and
facts of its drawings that the netlist does not keep. A file names it with USE-PACKAGE (16.2);
the core does not bundle it. Written in the language 0.4, as the standard series 0.4 is (decision
0017), so a file of 0.4 alone uses it; the symbols of earlier versions that the standard series
0.4 now has (the crystal, the polarized capacitor and the other parts 0.5 and 0.6 added, the
controlled-source diamonds, the pulse source, the chopper, the twisted differential op-amp) are
no longer here.
Coordinates are y-up; one unit is one grid step, ten Analog Canvas units. Each pin binds the
terminal of its name, as the standard symbols do (9.2.4): a subcircuit instance drawn with one
needs ports of these names, or terminals= on its SET-SYMBOL (11.3). The single-pole double-throw
switch, a figure, has pins that bind nothing, as the standard one does.

packages.name: eda-style

summary.zh: 独立样式包：绿色细线、红色符号文字、自动红色端子方块和等宽标签；适用于标准、eda-symbol 和自定义符号，符号几何由所用符号包提供。
summary.en: An independent visual package: green hairlines, red symbol text, automatic red terminal squares and monospaced labels for standard, eda-symbol and custom symbols; geometry comes from the chosen symbol package.

packages.description:
eda-style 0.1.
Universal IC schematic visual style package for RNL 0.3.
Applies green hairline symbol strokes (`linewidth=0, linecolor="#00cc66"`),
red symbol texts (`textcolor="#ff0000"`), solid red 0.8x0.8 terminal squares on all pins
via `@SELECT-TERMINAL`, solid red port polygons, hairline wires (`linewidth=0`), and a
monospaced font (`Lucida Console, Monaco, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace`).
Can be used standalone or paired with `eda-symbol` 0.1.

packages.name: eda-style

summary.en: An independent visual package for RNL 0.4: green hairlines, red symbol text, automatic red terminal squares on the pins of instances, grounds and supplies, and monospaced labels, for standard, eda-symbol and custom symbols, with rules that reach every level.

packages.description:
eda-style 0.2.
Universal IC schematic visual style package for RNL 0.4.
Applies green hairline symbol strokes (`linewidth=0, linecolor="#00cc66"`),
red symbol texts (`textcolor="#ff0000"`), solid red 0.8x0.8 terminal squares on the pins of
instances, grounds and supplies via `@SELECT-PIN`, solid red port polygons, hairline wires
(`linewidth=0`), and a monospaced font (`Lucida Console, Monaco, DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, monospace`).
Its rules write `recursive=true`, so they reach every level below the one that uses the package.
Can be used standalone or paired with `eda-symbol` 0.2.

packages.name: eda-symbol

summary.zh: 独立符号包：137 个不绑定配色的原理图符号和选用规则，引脚方向与标准库一致；可单独使用或搭配 eda-style。
summary.en: An independent package of 137 schematic symbols and selection rules, with no fixed colors and standard-compatible pin directions; use alone or with eda-style.

packages.description:
eda-symbol 0.1.
Streamlined, universal IC schematic symbol library for RNL 0.3.
Defines all 93 standard RNL 0.3 symbol names (`$RESISTOR`, `$CAPACITOR`, `$NMOS_4TERM`, `$OPAMP`,
`$AND_2INPUT`, etc.), 44 visually distinct universal IC schematic symbols (`$VSIN`, `$VPULSE`,
`$VPWL`, `$IDEAL_BALUN`, `$MIXER`, `$LOWPASS_FILTER`, `$VC_VG_DIFFAMP`, etc.), and instance/usage
symbol selection rules with pure, style-agnostic geometry. Pair with `eda-style` 0.1 for
green hairline strokes, red symbol texts, solid red terminal squares, and hairline wires.

packages.name: eda-symbol

summary.en: An independent package of 133 schematic symbols and selection rules for RNL 0.4, with no fixed colors: pins bind the terminal names of the standard series 0.4, the geometry of 0.1 is kept except that the diodes and the transformer stand upright as in that series, and its rules reach every level; use alone or with eda-style.

packages.description:
eda-symbol 0.2.
Streamlined, universal IC schematic symbol library for RNL 0.4.
Draws the symbols of the standard series 0.4 that it shares (`$RESISTOR`, `$CAPACITOR`, `$NMOS_4TERM`,
`$OPAMP`, `$AND_2INPUT`, etc.) in its own geometry, adds universal IC schematic symbols (`$VSIN`,
`$VPULSE`, `$VPWL`, `$IDEAL_BALUN`, `$MIXER`, `$LOWPASS_FILTER`, `$VC_VG_DIFFAMP`, etc.), and gives
instance and usage symbol selection rules with pure, style-agnostic geometry. Pins bind the terminal
names of the standard series 0.4; the eda-only symbols of masters without standard terminal names
bind by position. Pair with `eda-style` 0.2 for green hairline strokes, red symbol texts, solid red
terminal squares, and hairline wires.
